purpose: Confirm whether database-by-class balanced LoRA has a repeatable advantage over raw event-random LoRA.

shared_protocol.model: BEATs Iter3+ AS2M with rank-8 Q/V LoRA in blocks 8-11
shared_protocol.checkpoint_selection: worst-database Average Score, then mean-database Average Score

lower_bound_gate.interpretation: Low repeatability and relevance bounds, not final journal-level superiority thresholds.

decision_policy.if_passed: Retain database-class balancing as one component of the applied paper and proceed to exact-mask full-fine-tuning and calibration/rejection stages.
decision_policy.if_failed: Do not claim sampling as a central contribution and do not access locked tests.
